milestones.name: PSB Registration
milestones.description: Register at local Public Security Bureau within 30 days of arrival in Shenzhen.

milestones.name: Open Bank Account (ICBC)
milestones.description: Open RMB student account with passport, X-visa, PSB cert, and admission notice for Shenzhen University.

milestones.name: Activate UnionPay Debit Card
milestones.description: Activate UnionPay card for domestic payments and contactless POS in Shenzhen.

milestones.name: Tuition Payment (Shenzhen University)
milestones.description: Pay official tuition (CNY 28,000) via CNAPS direct to Shenzhen University official account. Payee must be verified.

milestones.name: Rent Deposit
milestones.description: Transfer rent deposit via UnionPay debit card directly to landlord/dormitory.

milestones.name: Setup Alipay / WeChat Pay
milestones.description: Link digital wallets to domestic account for campus dining and daily expenses in INR equivalent.

milestones.name: Apply for Secured Credit Card
milestones.description: Apply after 3-month account history with steady inbound remittances. No approval guaranteed.

milestones.name: First PBOC Credit Reference Report
milestones.description: Request official PBOC credit report after 6 months of active UnionPay card usage.
